readRouteRoster's ctx.Done branch now carries an ErrUnavailable-wrapped error so a cancelled agents read answers 503 rather than a nil-error path.

The uncached switch is read from Deps (simplify pass), so DISPATCH_TEST_ROSTER_UNCACHED reaches the server through bootConfig -> routes.AppContextOptions -> api.DepsInput -> api.Deps; routes/router.go was the plumbing hop the plan did not list.

The drain fallback lives in listAgents, not readRouteRoster: the shared fetch keeps its shutdown rule (TestAShutdownEndsAFetchInFlight), issue reads keep reading unknown during a drain as at base, and only an agents list, which base served from the listener on the request context, does so again.
